answer: Pay rewards on a curve that flattens as identities cluster: when many accounts share a funding source, device fingerprint, or voting pattern, the network treats them as one nebula and splits a single capped payout among them, so minting ten thousand clones earns no more than one honest agent. An attacker sailing an ocean of puppets finds each extra sail adds almost nothing, while a zephyr of newcomers, each with distinct history, keeps full weight. Limits: honest households sharing a wallet look like a farm, and clustering must stay transparent and appealable, or it punishes real communities.
